description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseCalendarService' implementing calendar operations such as creating, updating, deleting events, and fetching calendar data. It handles iCalendar data processing, timezone management, and integration with CalDAV and other calendar protocols.

classes.name: BaseCalendarService
classes.description: An abstract class providing core calendar functionalities such as event creation, update, deletion, and fetching calendar data, with timezone and recurrence handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the calendar service with credentials, URL, and logger.

methods.name: getAttendees
methods.description: Generates attendee list including team members excluding current user.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event, generates ICS data, injects timezone info, and uploads to calendar.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event identified by UID with new details.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event by UID from all associated calendars.

methods.name: getUserTimezoneFromDB
methods.description: Fetches user's timezone from the database.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Extracts user ID from the first calendar in the list.

methods.name: isValidFormat
methods.description: Checks if a URL has a supported calendar file extension (.eml, .ics).

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Fetches busy dates within a specified range from selected calendars.

methods.name: fetchObjectsWithOptionalExpand
methods.description: Fetches calendar objects with optional expand, handling missing data by re-fetching without expand.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists available calendars with their external IDs and names.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events from a specific calendar within a date range.

methods.name: getEventsByUID
methods.description: Finds all events matching a specific UID across calendars.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Creates and returns a DAV account object for calendar operations.
